description: Sanctions screening API for KYB/KYC and compliance agents: check whether a person or company name matches the OFAC SDN and other sanctions lists, with fuzzy matching, alias handling and a 0-1 match score per hit. Generic legal-form words (LLC, Ltd, Holdings) are ignored to avoid false positives. Use before onboarding, paying or contracting a counterparty. Screening aid, not legal advice. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC, Base).

_payment.description: Optional base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE payload. Omit to receive payment requirements.

name.description: Person or organization name to screen

name: agentbit.sanctions_screen
